rounds.notes:
**❗OVERVIEW**

This is the most simple round, we are focusing on anything weapon related, and we buy a survival item so we don't die immediately & so we can use the 1.5k left over.

Coins are going to be the most important thing for [Mercy](hero_0e213bfc-3ca9-49c6-9036-e7f344b752da), do NOT be wasting your coins! They are vital in the long run. For this round, buy two 1k items and one 1.5k item.

**❗POWER**

We buy [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) here. Why? It is one of her BEST early game power. Despite the nerf, it is still a great power to start the game off. It allows you to DB or heal two teammates at once. You can easily farm cash and if you have a dive character --- beam them - they tp -- out of los/range? beam your other DPS! It's awesome for enabling a dive comp early game.

**❗ITEMS**

Since the power we chose focuses on our staff, both of my 1k cash abilities are going to be for  [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and  [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed). The two items that fit this are 
- [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) 
- [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf)

We now need a 1.5k item, so I always go for a survival item. The two I use most often are
- [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) 
- [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) 

Both of these are great options. I prefer the former since shields regen quicker than support passive, but they are interchangeable.

round_upgrades.notes: Imo, this can be interchangeable with armored vest.
Imo, this can be interchangeable with first aid kit.

Great ability that allows you to db or heal two targets at once. Since Crepsular Capsule was removed, it's now the only ability that let's you DB multiple targets. I recommend this to be your first power, it allows you to gain your ult charge quicker and provides more value in early game unlike other powers.

rounds.notes:
**❗OVERVIEW**

We are still prioritizing [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) since it's still early game. 

**❗ITEMS**
By the end of the round, you should have enough cash to buy 
- [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) 
- [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a)
These are the two best WP/AS items for early game.

***❗EXTRA COINS?***

Depending on how much you have left over, buy these items (in order). 
- [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) 
- [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) 
- [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) or  [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) 

**❗NOT ENOUGH COINS?**

After selling all your other items and you can afford one or the other, buy
- [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e)
It gives you 5% [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and 10% [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) after healing an ally, which I would consider to be a much better trade off than the flat 15% [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) that [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) gives you.

* If you have more left over but not enough for  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), buy*
-[Angeleisure Wear](item_00b53ed7-0768-442b-a2c3-8d19608c9391) for extra survival.

rounds.notes:
**❗OVERVIEW**

We are still going to be focusing WP for this round too! I know the AP takes a while but just trust me. Building a good foundation here is *CRUCIAL*.

**❗POWER**

For this round we are going with 
- [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4)!!

I know I know, "Why not [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9)?". We are going with Triage Unit so we can get all we can out of [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) until we have enough cash for our [Ability Power](stat_ability_power). The hybrid build can be *very* expensive, and if we put resources into AP right now, we won't have enough for it to be worthwhile.

We also go with this since it synergizes with BOTH [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) from her staff and [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) from [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9)! It can help us before and after we make our AP build work~!

**❗ITEMS**

Usually by this round the only thing I can buy is 
- [Blessed Boosters](item_957fd380-b7b4-40d4-8333-bb8c535ca931) 

If I have extra cash I'll buy
- [Angeleisure Wear](item_00b53ed7-0768-442b-a2c3-8d19608c9391) if I didn't get it last round. If you have extra cash, just buy random WP/AS items!
